title: Upper & Lower Quartiles and Percentiles of Grouped Data

titles.subject: Statistics
titles.chapter: Quartiles, Percentiles and Measures of Dispersion
titles.leaf: Upper & Lower Quartiles and Percentiles of Grouped Data

author: 696637e49d26457b33c7eff3
chapter_outcomes: Find the quartiles of a small data set and an ungrouped frequency distribution.

Estimate the quartiles and percentiles of a grouped frequency distribution, and find the percentile corresponding to a given value of the variable. From a cumulative frequency polygon or curve and by linear interpolation. Including estimation of frequencies in given parts of the distribution.
Calculate the range of a small data set and an ungrouped frequency distribution.
Calculate the interquartile range of a small data set and an ungrouped frequency distribution.
Estimate of the interquartile range of a grouped frequency distribution. From a cumulative frequency polygon or curve, and by linear interpolation.

Calculate the standard deviation of a small data set and an ungrouped frequency distribution, and calculate an estimate of the standard deviation of a grouped frequency distribution. Candidates are expected to recall and use a formula for standard deviation, e.g.: Standard deviation = √(Σ(x - x̄)²/n), Standard deviation = √(Σx²/n - (Σx/n)²)
Understand the advantages and disadvantages of each measure of dispersion and justify the use of a particular measure of dispersion in context.
